gr-xendit-7992374003.d:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.

Why this role exists

For a payment-infrastructure company, the product is in large part the API. Developers are both the buyers and the daily users, and the quality of the APIs, SDKs, docs, sandbox, and integration path is the product's real surface. This role owns the developer's journey from first API call to production and scale, the difference between a developer who integrates in an afternoon and one who gives up before their first successful transaction.

What you'll own

• The roadmap for the developer experience: integration flow, SDKs, documentation, sandbox, error handling, and time-to-first-successful-call.
• Developer activation and retention as headline metrics, from sign-up to first production transaction and beyond.
• Discovery grounded in developer behavior: integration analytics, support and community signals, and direct developer research.
• Partnership with Engineering on API design and DX standards, and prioritization of DX debt against new capabilities.
• Clear communication of trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and translation of platform changes into a coherent developer-facing experience.

How you will work

You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and work most closely with Engineering, whose API and platform decisions shape the experience you own. Part of your early work is helping define where developer-experience ownership sits, since this surface has not had a dedicated product owner before. You are the strategic owner of the developer journey from first API call to production. Your time splits between developer discovery and roadmap delivery, with constant engineering partnership. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.

What we're looking for

• PM experience with API, platform, or developer-facing products. You have owned products where developers are the user.
• Genuine technical fluency. You can read API docs and discuss schemas, auth, and webhooks with engineers, here this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
• Demonstrated empathy for developer workflows. You understand how developers actually work and where they get stuck.

A strong plus: a background as a developer, or having built SDK, docs, or DX products; payments or fintech experience.

wo-jpfa-JR2376.d:
Job Summary:**

The Sales Promotion Supervisor at PT Japfa Food Indonesia is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing sales promotion activities to drive brand awareness, increase sales, and achieve marketing objectives. This role involves leading a team, coordinating with various departments, and ensuring the effective implementation of promotional strategies across different channels.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement strategic sales promotion plans aligned with overall marketing goals and sales targets.
* Lead, mentor, and supervise a team of sales promotion staff, including training, performance management, and scheduling.
* Coordinate with the marketing department to ensure seamless integration of promotional activities with broader marketing campaigns.
* Collaborate with the sales team to identify promotional opportunities and support sales initiatives.
* Manage the budget for sales promotion activities, ensuring cost-effective execution and optimal ROI.
* Oversee the execution of in-store promotions, sampling events, trade shows, and other promotional activities.
* Negotiate with vendors and suppliers for promotional materials, prizes, and event logistics.
* Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of promotional campaigns, providing regular reports and recommendations for improvement.
* Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and consumer behavior to identify new promotional opportunities.
* Ensure all promotional activities comply with company policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards.
* Prepare detailed reports on promotion performance, including sales lift, customer engagement, and budget utilization.

Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in sales promotion, marketing, or a related field, with at least 1-2 years in a supervisory role.
* Proven track record of successfully planning and executing sales promotion campaigns.
* Strong understanding of consumer goods industry, preferably within the food sector.
* Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
* Ability to travel frequently to various locations for promotional activities.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
